messages:
ash: Quick PSA — release cutoff in ~2h. Please add your release entry (one concise bullet) and bump the version if you changed any public API. I’ll do a sweep 30m before cutoff. :eyes:

jess: Ack. My PR touches client pagination headers — is that a 'client' entry or 'core-http'? @ash

ash: Use 'client' for SDK-facing behavior. Entry shape example — paste this into your PR description under Release Notes:

```
- client: fix pagination when results are empty (owner: @jess)
```

One line, present-tense, short. If it needs a migration note, append `(migration: short note)` after the owner.

maria: I have an infra-only change (rolling restart order). Should that be 'infra' or 'ops'?

ash: 'infra' is fine. Tag 'infra' so platform sees it. And run the linter locally: `./scripts/check_release_notes.sh` — it flags missing components/owners.

release-bot: Reminder: release note validation will run on merge. To run locally: `tools/release/validate_notes --ci`.

tom: Quick on the version bump — do we want the bump commit to have a specific prefix? Also, where exactly does the bump live (root VERSION file or package files)?

ash: Good Q. Commit subject should start with `release:` and include the new version, e.g. `release: bump v0.12.3 -> v0.12.4`. Put the canonical bump in the top-level VERSION and add per-package updates as follow-ups. PR description should include the single release bullet.

jess: Done — PR #4821 includes the entry and a `release:` bump commit. Tagged @maria for infra visibility.

maria: Saw it, added a tiny migration note about the restart flag rename `(migration: restart_flag -> restart_order)`. CI looks flakey on one test, will re-run and merge after it passes. :memo:

ash: Awesome. If anyone's unsure about component names or phrasing, ping me or drop the raw sentence here and I’ll trim it down. I’ll do a final sweep 30m before cutoff. :white_check_mark: :rocket:
